pageDescription: FAS Expedition – Career opportunities at FAS Expedition. Join our team in Lammersdorf.

hero.title: Careers
hero.subtitle: Join the team! We're constantly looking for reinforcements for our young team.

intro:
FAS Expedition GmbH is a young company in the expedition vehicle market. With our two main divisions "Vehicle Construction" and "Cabin Construction", we offer our customers an off-road capable world-travel vehicle from a single source.

If you share our passion for travel or can imagine being part of the world of expedition vehicles — check our current openings below. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Interior Builder / Caravan Technician (m/f/d)
tasks: Interior construction of premium expedition vehicles
Routing and connection of electrical, water, heating, and climate systems
Installation of solar systems, TV, WiFi infrastructure, and appliances
Fitting additional equipment: exterior lighting, camera/alarm systems, outdoor kitchens
profile: Vocational training in caravan/electrical/installation technology, vehicle electronics, or boat building
Passion for visual and functional perfection with premium materials
Experience with mobile IT infrastructure and smart device control
Good communication skills and willingness to represent our products at trade fairs
benefits: Direct reporting to the Technical Director

jobs.title: Metalworker / Commercial Vehicle Technician (m/f/d)
tasks: Manufacturing and assembly of attachments: subframes, rear carriers, storage boxes, fuel tanks, and more
Fitting additional equipment: lighting, camera systems, winches, tire pressure regulation systems
profile: Vocational training in metalwork or vehicle construction, preferably commercial vehicles
Passion for (commercial) vehicles and working with steel
Steady hand with welding equipment (TIG and MIG/MAG)
Solid knowledge in vehicle electrics, electronics, hydraulics, and pneumatics
Good communication skills and team spirit
benefits: Reporting to the Vehicle Construction Workshop Manager
